status: Assistant-development engineering comparison frozen before training; established augmentation and derivative-supervision baselines, not novel theory or student preregistration
purpose: Improve forward and derivative quality through a fixed 2x2 training/validation-only comparison; report every candidate and retain negative results

dataset.isolation: Original parent assignments stay fixed; verify train/validation parent and slice disjointness without opening calibration or test arrays

training.batch_sampling: Seeded shuffled permutation cycles concatenated across epoch boundaries to form exactly 32 examples per optimizer update; equal optimizer-update budgets rather than equal epochs
training.initialization: Reset the same torch seed before constructing each candidate
training.normalization: Shared normalization from raw TRAIN model/frequency inputs and recomputed raw TRAIN teacher wavefields only; validation never determines normalization

states.training_augmented: Raw training examples followed by one velocity-smoothed state for every training example; no new independent parents are claimed
states.validation: Identical concatenated raw and smoothed states from every original validation example for every candidate
states.storage: Squared-slowness state inputs are float32 before teacher recomputation; no clipping or validation-driven transformations

teacher.state_labels: Recompute exact states at stored float32 model inputs converted to float64, using original source indices and frequencies
teacher.tangent_labels: One fixed fresh Gaussian squared-slowness direction per state, normalized to unit L2, then stored float32; recompute exact tangent at those same stored model/direction inputs
teacher.direction_seed_algorithm: SeedSequence([direction_seed, role_code, state_code]); train=0, validation=1; raw=0, smoothed=1
teacher.shared_labels: All candidates share the same raw training labels, augmented training labels, and complete validation labels/directions; no calibration/test labels generated or loaded
teacher.saved_field_dtype: float32 real/imaginary channels from complex128 reference solves
teacher.cost_scope: Record all shared offline label-generation factorizations/RHS costs separately from neural training and validation time

loss.relative_squared_l2: sum((prediction-target)^2) / max(sum(target^2), 1e-20) per example, jointly over physical real/imaginary channels
loss.training_forward: full-field physical relative squared L2 + 0.25 * receiver physical relative squared L2
loss.training_derivative: candidate derivative_weight * full-field physical relative squared L2 JVP loss
loss.tangent_decoding: Multiply normalized tangent channels by TRAIN output standard deviations, with no mean/centering term

selection.score: Equal-parent mean validation receiver physical relative squared L2 + equal-parent mean validation full-field physical relative squared L2 JVP loss + (1 - equal-parent mean aggregate inverse-gradient cosine), all unit weights
selection.parent_weighting: Each original validation parent has equal weight; examples are averaged within parent across both state types and all its source/frequency blocks
selection.checkpoint_eligible_updates: 100,200,...,2000; initial update-zero validation is a reported diagnostic baseline only
selection.reporting: All three score components, actual aggregate inverse-gradient cosine/descent/norms, all histories, all four candidates, all best checkpoints, and the selected artifact; do not choose candidates using calibration/test/external outcomes
selection.deployment: No calibration/test/external evaluation until a separate winner/protocol freeze by the root workflow

validation_inverse_cases.case_definition: Every unique original validation slice, without subsampling; each parent retains all its slices
validation_inverse_cases.evaluation_state: Stored float32 squared slowness from sigma-1.6 reflect-smoothed velocity
validation_inverse_cases.observations: Recomputed raw validation teacher wavefields restricted to the original receivers
validation_inverse_cases.objective: Sum of 0.5 * squared complex receiver residual norm over all original source/frequency blocks for that slice
validation_inverse_cases.exact_gradient: Precompute the aggregate exact squared-slowness gradient once per slice with full offline costs retained
validation_inverse_cases.neural_gradient: Autodifferentiate the same summed receiver objective with respect to a shared model input per slice, batched over blocks
validation_inverse_cases.cosine: Real model-space cosine, zero if either gradient L2 norm <= 1e-14; retain zero-gradient flags rather than resampling or excluding cases
validation_inverse_cases.neural_descent_direction: Negative aggregate neural gradient normalized to unit L2; zero direction if neural norm <= 1e-14
validation_inverse_cases.true_descent: Aggregate exact gradient dotted with the neural descent direction is strictly negative
validation_inverse_cases.aggregation: Average metrics within each original parent, then average parents equally; report every original slice and parent

scope.claim: Bounded exploratory training comparison on 17 training and four model-selection validation parents; no independent confirmation, production certification, or acceleration claim
